query: What happens when Samsung Galaxy A51 buyers contact the seller or manufacturer about a faulty phone or a refund?
search_text: What happens when buyers contact the seller or manufacturer about a faulty phone or a refund?

rows.text: No as described no communication. Phone was not as described,returned Sept 1st,contacted the seller several times,no refund issued.
Had to return.. Did not work. We troubleshooted with Amazon Care. Talked to the seller. My guess - faulty phone. My luck to to get it. Easy to return. Refunded fully. Seller communicated.

BUYER BEWARE. The seller knows these phones are out of warranty from Samsung. They were originally returned for a reason. The seller does not offer any trouble shooting. I have had 3 of these paper weights and all 3 have the same problem. They disconect from your service provider and as a result incoming calls do not ring. The calls are sent to voice mail. Also you are unable to make calls untill you turn the phone off and restart it. This only happens at random intervals. So, there is no way to tell if the phone is working or not. Buy a new phone from Amazon and get a manufacturers warranty. DO NOT BUY AMAZON REFURBISHED!

Slow and the Battery drain so quickly. I got the phone and I used it for 3 months. the seller gives you 90 days for a refund or replacement. after the second month, the battery started to drain so quickly so if you have a 100% charge it will drop to 0 without using it before the day ends and you didn't even make a phone call. because I don't typically return anything unless it's a big deal. the 3 months passed and I'm in the 4th month I contact the seller, not for a refund or exchange but to fix it. he said you are out of the warranty. My advice is to stay away from any refurbished phone as much as you could and If you cannot then choose the one that has only 100% positive reviews and is keen to listen
Received and it did not work. 1st phone was received and did not work. I exchanged it and the next one got lost in shipping. I was not able to replace it and got a refund.
Phones works fine, seller charged $50 more then tracfone. Seller charged $50 more then tracfone and Amazon would not stop the order 1 hr after i ordered

Samsung A51 White. Beautiful phone. Appeared to work good. Paid extra for an 'excellent' condition phone that was to be in 'excellent' working order. But, the rear camera does not work. I suppose the seller didn't try it out before shipping it. Ran down the list all of the things to try, even factory reset it and it still does not work. Fun thing to find out after hours of trouble shooting. Buyer beware.

Lied to, false description (NOT unlocked). I bought this phone as I have bought other refurbished items before elsewhere, and have never had any issues. My husband needed a new phone so I thought yay! The phone worked at first for about 60 days, before we noticed that it wouldn't update. We would install, then at the download it would fail 23-25% stating an error, and failed. We contacted both this seller's support and Amazon support to try and figure this out. We restarted the phone multiple times, and factory reset completely multiple times. This never fixed the issue. The company stated it should work but I can send back for a refund. As this day in age, it's difficult to be without a phone, I tried buying a new one first and was sold a scratched up one which I'll be returning immediately.

I need confirmation of refund.. At first device worked perfectly. Then power button gave me trouble. Sent item back... before 30 day limit... nothing.425.00 stolen... AND I'M A PRIME MEMBER!GIVE MY MONEY BACK,OR THE PHONE. I WILL HAVE LEGAL PROCEDURES INSTATED.

Horrible Battery Life and Poor Communication. I received my phone and loved it. I updated the phone and the very next day, I found it couldn't hold a charge. I am extremely disappointed. On top of all that, I was told to send my phone back for a replacement and I would receive an updated tracking number of the new one they would send me. Instead, after 14 days, I had to reach out to the company to check my status of the replacement, and was told I was refunded and I would not be getting a replacement. After much confusion, I need to contact my bank to make sure I received a refund, which is not showing up on my end. I am not happy with my overall experience with this company.

Sold with INVALID SIM card ...can not recommend seller. It would be nice if you're selling a used cell ... to make sure it's not still connected to the carrier ... with a number on it ... A 7 HOUR HASSLE ON THE PHONE ... to try and get it activated ... and ONLY through persistence did I get it done ... DO NOT BUY USED PHONE ... I LEARNED THE HARD WAY ... I assume had I bought it from Amazon ... I would not have had the PAIN THIS SELLER CAUSED ... BEWARE

Failed after 5 months of light use. This phone initially worked but failed completely after 5 month of light use. Nothing happened to the phone wasn’t dropped was damaged etc just went dark and never came back on. Lost data pictures messages etc buyer beware. And seller won’t do a thing or even offer some kind of restitution.

I was sent a faulty phone. Absolutely horrible service. It doesn't decipher English very well at all while doing talk to text. Drops calls or prison can't hear me. Doesn't always give me notifications. Nothing but problems since I activated it. I even went and bought another new sim card per Samsung suggesting that may be the problem but nothing has worked.
Black screen after 3 months. Screen went black after three months. Manufacturer would not repair under warranty, claiming damage to the phone.

PHONE IS LOCKED!. Was sold a LOCKED phone! UPDATE... after emailing the seller i sent the phone back only for them to say the screen is cracked which i did not do and there is a 50% restocking fee so DO NOT WASTE YOUR TIME buying this phone!
no good. dose not work good need a refund.
Garbage. About a week past the return window this phone went to crap... don't trust this seller

BUYERS BEWARE OF THIS SELLER!!!! BATERY LIFE IS JUNK!!!. The battery life with this phone is a joke,I have had a galaxy a51 on straight talk,and the battery on that phone was great id get home at night when it was time for bed,11pm, 12am and have atleast 40%,if not 60% battery left,this one here is at 10% at 10am, very unhappy with it, I get it,this wasn't a "BRAND NEW " it was a "REFERBISHED" well I thought refurbished meant that certain things got replaced to make the phone as good as new, I KNOW NOW THAT REFERBISHED JUST MEANS BIG PIECE OF CRAP!

Scam. I purchased this phone with confidence because I hadn't ever had a problem with anything purchased before. This was a nightmare of epic proportions. When I got the SIM card and started the activation process, I got a warning box that stayed the phone couldn't be activated and to call Verizon. That is a challenge as well. After two days of trying to get someone to talk to me I got a woman that said they couldn't remove the block because the phone was reported as stolen. When I bought it, it said it was a new phone, in the factory box. I am returning the phone and hoping the seller refunds my purchase price.

Waste of money. I've had the phone for 6 months and the screen went black. I contacted the company I purchased the protection plan with and was told they couldn't file a claim because it was still covered under a manufacturer warranty. They told me to contact Samsung. When I did, I was told they couldn't do anything because it's a Tracfone and I would need to call them. Tracfone told me they couldn't do anything and they would suggest I go on YouTube to figure it out. Don't waste your money.
